question: In which list of the Seventh Schedule does the Central Government have exclusive power to legislate?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Union List**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Union List** is one of the three lists defined in the **Seventh Schedule** of the **Indian Constitution**.
 
• It contains subjects on which only the **Central Government** has the exclusive power to legislate.
 
• The Union List currently includes 100&am
